data.narrative:
Kreios Space is a seed-stage aerospace company that has raised €8M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Rocket Lab and Sierra Space, though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier overlap for reliable median benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method. Using total capital raised (€8M) as a proxy for seed-stage value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing round yields €20M. This reflects observed progression patterns from seed to Series A in the sector.

Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because Kreios Space's revenue is not disclosed, preventing use of the sector's median 25.3x price-to-sales multiple. Peer-median methodology was rejected due to insufficient comparable datapoints meeting narrow stage and tier filters across the identified private peer universe.

The valuation range supported by available data is €17M (low) to €23M (high), with a central point of €20M. This range reflects only one applicable methodology and carries material uncertainty around revenue trajectory, technology maturity, and competitive positioning—factors typically material to seed-stage aerospace valuations but not quantifiable from the data provided.
